cohort: 113 neonates born to mothers with eclampsia
finding: Maternal eclampsia was associated with a high rate of neonatal morbidity, including prematurity, growth restriction, low birth weight, and neonatal death.
gest_age: Not specified, but study included premature infants
followup_time: Neonatal period (until hospital discharge or death)
birth_weight: Not specified, but study included low birth weight infants
